chart_review_items.title: Add correlation matrix to scatter exploration
chart_review_items.current_state: No correlation-matrix family is registered; scatter requires choosing a pair directly.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Users discover relationships across several numeric fields and immediately inspect a pair.
acceptance_criteria: Method, population, and valid-pair count are visible.
Constant and insufficient-data fields produce unavailable results, not zero correlation.
Missing-value policy is explicit and tested.
Cell activation opens the corresponding scatter configuration rather than inventing a record filter.
Large field lists have a bounded, usable selection workflow.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Explore relationships and inspect selected records
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: Scatter now has row tracing, point/range selection, bubble area and rectangular density bins.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Regression/uncertainty/hexagons/marginals/contours are planned, not delivered. Overlap, size provenance and exclusion visibility need current browser proof.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

warning: Unchanged selected historical Pro records. Current assessment is in the intent brief and collection disposition ledger.

current_assessment.statement: pairedSummary.ts already computes Pearson correlation for grouped finite pairs and unavailable constant cases. The registry has no relationship-matrix view. Scatter regression and surfaces are live source implementations, unlike the older Pro snapshot.
current_assessment.evidence_scope: Source inspection only; no fresh application browser proof.
